_doc: Break The Silence (Anjali Rawat). One 4K source with a hard camera cut at 13.4s (the taunts are a separate take). Each range is one shot; every cut is a straight cut with the framing alternating close / medium. Pauses are removed at the cuts; short natural pauses inside a range are kept. Every range ends ~0.25s after its last word has died away.
